summary: Apply road traffic safety methods to fleet and agency risks, controls and KPIs. Review the five-day course outline and plan your training.
lede: Road traffic safety management training helps fleet and public-agency professionals apply the ISO 39001:2012 management-system approach to transport safety. It covers reviewing crash and exposure data, prioritizing driver, vehicle and journey risks, and defining practical controls and performance measures. Participants use the Safe System approach and Haddon Matrix to support collision reviews, journey-control planning and management dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who plan, monitor or govern road use and fleet safety, including public agencies and transport operators working with varied vehicle fleets and road conditions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with fleet operations, road safety, transport services or public road management is recommended. Routine spreadsheet use is helpful; coding or programming is not required.
